formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO (Aldrich, MW = 400,000) homopolymer complexed with lithium salts (LiClO4, LiI, LiCF3SO3); called composite electrolytes but no filler added
formulations.Arrhenius notes: Ea (±0.01 eV) from least-squares straight-line fits of dc conductivity (from complex impedance) vs 1/T, sigma = sigma0 exp(-Ea/kBT). The paper says all plots are linear over the measured range, which is roughly 273–308 K judging from the ac data temperatures. The activation energy of the crossover frequency (Ec) agrees closely with Ea. No prefactor values are reported.
formulations.Notes: Paper gives PEO 'MW = 400 000' without saying if it is Mw or viscosity-average. Vacuum-dried anhydrous salts (Aldrich); solution stirred 8-10 h at room temperature, cast in PTFE containers, then vacuum dried at 0.01 mbar, 60 °C, 36 h to give free-standing films. Conductivity measured with stainless steel blocking electrodes in an anhydrous environment; Arrhenius behaviour across the whole range.
formulations.Reference: A. Karmakar and A. Ghosh, J. Appl. Phys. 107, 104113 (2010)
